module: Automatic gearbox logic (modes P R N D S 1-9 M, torque converter with partial lockup). Loaded by vehicleController when the "gearbox" device is of type automaticGearbox. Depending on the gearbox mode (arcade or realistic), it decides the target gear from the shift points (aggression, slip), handles throttle/brake (automatic inversion in reverse in arcade, auto brake at standstill) and converter lockup (electrics.values.lockupClutchRatio).
usage:
-- from another controller or the vehicle console
controller.mainController.shiftToGearIndex(0) -- delegated to this module
-- jbeam: "automaticModes":"PRNDS21M", "torqueConverterLockupRPM":1800
notes: jbeam keys read in init: automaticModes (default "PRNDS21M"; letters P R N D S 1-9 M, "M" is replaced by M1..Mn depending on maxGearIndex), hShifterModePositions (table mode -> lever index; default {[-1]=R,[0]=N,P,D,S,2,1,M1}), defaultAutomaticMode (N), defaultAutomaticForwardMode (first forward mode, otherwise D), maxGearChangeTime / minGearChangeTime / sportGearChangeTime (0), autoDownShiftInM (true), autoDownShiftInMMinGear (2), throttleCoefWhileShifting (1), torqueConverterLockupRPM, torqueConverterLockupRange, torqueConverterLockupMinGear (0), torqueConverterHasPartialLockup (true), torqueConverterMinPartialLockupRatio or torqueConverterLockupRatioWhileShifting (0.67), partialLockupTipInThreshold (0.85), partialLockupTipInGain (1.5), torqueConverterLockupRate (5), torqueConverterLockupInRate (2x rate), torqueConverterLockupOutRate (rate).
Converter lockup is active only if torqueConverterLockupRPM > 0 and a "torqueConverter" device exists.

Common contract of the shiftLogic modules: gearboxHandling, timer, timerConstants, inputValues, shiftPreventionData, shiftBehavior, smoothedValues are injected by vehicleController (nil until injected).
updateGearboxGFX is nop at creation then replaced in gearboxBehaviorChanged by the "inGear" function of the current gearbox mode, and temporarily by "whileShifting" during a gear change.
In arcade mode, shiftUp/shiftDown only display a warning (warnCannotShiftSequential) and shiftToGearIndex switches to realistic.
Inconsistency: init sets M.minGearIndex = abs(minGearIndex) whereas updateExposedData (every frame) replaces it with gearbox.minGearIndex (signed).
M.running and M.isShifting are written by updateExposedData without being declared initially.

applyGearboxModeRestrictions can store strings (M mode index extracted from the string) in maxGearIndex/minGearIndex, then compared with numbers: Lua converts numeric strings for arithmetic but not for < / > comparisons between a string and a number (risk of error); only inferred from code.

throttle.desc: Decided throttle (0..1), possibly inverted in arcade reverse or limited during a shift.

brake.desc: Decided brake (0..1); in arcade, at least arcadeAutoBrakeAmount at standstill without throttle.

currentGearIndex.desc: Gear index targeted by the logic.

minGearIndex.desc: Smallest gear index (reverse); see notes on the sign.

isArcadeSwitched.desc: True when throttle and brake are swapped (arcade, reverse).

smoothedAvgAVInput.desc: Gearbox output angular velocity (rad/s), used by vehicleController.

engineThrottle.desc: Throttle actually applied to the engine.

isEngineRunning.desc: 1 if the engine is running, 0 otherwise.

checkEngine.desc: True if the engine is disabled.

updateGearboxGFX.desc: Current decision loop: nop, then inGear/whileShifting of the active gearbox mode.

init.desc: Reads the devices (mainEngine, gearbox, torqueConverter), builds the mode list, the H-shifter table, the lockup parameters and applies the default mode. Called by vehicleController (init and reset).

gearboxBehaviorChanged.desc: Called by vehicleController on an arcade/realistic change: chooses the matching logic and, in arcade, resets the mode (default forward mode, R or N depending on the gear).

areShiftLEDsInUse.desc: True if not in arcade and in manual M mode.

getGearName.desc: Displayed gear name: P/R/N/D, "S<n>" in S mode, "M<n>" in manual, otherwise the mode name.

getGearPosition.desc: Lever position for animation: (index-1)/(number of modes-1) and mode index.

setDefaultForwardMode.desc: Sets the default "forward" mode (D, S, M1...) and applies it if already driving forward.

mode.desc: Mode name ("M1" switches to manual on the current gear).

shiftUp.desc: Realistic mode: advances one step in the mode list (P->R->N->D...). With gearboxSafety, refuses a manual gear that would make the engine exceed maxAV.

shiftDown.desc: Realistic mode: goes back one step in the mode list. With gearboxSafety, refuses to downshift below M1 above 2 m/s or a gear that would over-rev.

shiftToGearIndex.desc: Realistic mode: selects the mode matching the H-shifter lever position (hShifterModePositions); nonexistent mode -> message and N.

index.desc: Lever position (-1 R, 0 N, 1.. according to the table).

sendTorqueData.desc: Asks the engine to send its torque curves to the UI.

setState.desc: Restores the current mode from data.grb_mde.
